symbols.docstringSummary: Maps a direction index through the actor collision table, switches to bank 6, and tests background tile solidity.
Switches to PRG bank 6 to run projectile collision/movement at 0xF1ED for a slot and restores bank 0.
Copies the four primary actor sprite slots to backup slots, clears active actor states and alert flag, and invokes bank 0 alert cleanup.
Ticks the global alert timer and iterates over all 8 actor slots to spawn reinforcements or dispatch each active actor's AI behavior.
Routes an actor slot to its type-specific AI handler via the inline jump table or invokes enemy firing when actor type is 0xF0.
Switches to PRG bank 3 to invoke the actor behavior dispatcher and restores the previously active PRG bank.
Switches to PRG bank 4 to invoke the actor behavior dispatcher and restores the previously active PRG bank.
Checks whether the current room ID and sampled tile ID in 0x8F match the special lookup tables at 0xE630.
Evaluates squared distances and tile/room collision across four cardinal directions for an actor slot and dispatches movement toward the bes
Computes the 16-bit squared distance from an actor's stepped position in a candidate direction to the player in zero-page 0x80-0x82.
No-op actor handler stub that returns immediately.
Updates an actor's alert transition, hit-reaction sprite animation, path sync flag, and dispatches by AI substate at 0xA8+slot.
Single-instruction return stub that performs no operation.
Advances an actor's patrol script command and timer from bank table 0x8048, entering a wait state or returning actor status.
Executes an actor's patrol script bytecode on even frames, updating direction, animation frame, pause/alert opcodes, or firing enemy shots.
Selects and stores the animated walking sprite ID for an actor based on direction, frame counter, and actor type.
Applies a health pickup value from table 0xDE2B, sets room init mode to 3, and returns the actor to state 1.
Transitions an actor into state 6 and resets its alert event flag, animation index, and step timer.
Animates an actor's alert or exclamation overlay sprites until its countdown expires, then restores state 1.
Dispatches an actor movement step by direction bits via the inline jump table, or sets room init mode 8 in room 0xC7 when negative.
Increments an actor's Y coordinate in 0x0348 up to the lower screen limit of 0xF1.
Decrements an actor's Y coordinate in 0x0348 if it is greater than zero.
Increments an actor's X coordinate in 0x0328 up to the right screen limit of 0xA8.
Decrements an actor's X coordinate in 0x0328 if it is greater than zero.
Transitions an actor to pause state 2 and sets a randomized look counter and duration timer from the frame counter.
Ticks an actor's pause-and-look timer, cycles idle facing sprites, and transitions back to state 1 when complete.
Initializes an actor's patrol script, selects a chase direction toward the player, sets AI substate 4, and triggers alert or footstep SFX.
Assigns an actor's script offset in 0xB0 from lookup table 0xDF7A using its sub-index.
Decrements an actor's step timer and advances movement in its current direction if clear, or transitions to substate 5 when blocked.
Computes Manhattan deltas between the player and an actor slot, stores the longer axis step count, and returns the cardinal chase direction.
Runs actor pathfinding toward the player and sets a bounded wait timer in substate 4.
Gates actor firing frequency by frame counter and weapon sprite state before invoking enemy shot firing and projectile stepping.
Fires an enemy shot for an actor slot via 0xE07A and steps the corresponding enemy projectile slot if active.
Spawns and advances an aimed actor projectile sprite toward the player's current coordinates.
Polls attract-mode demo inputs and jumps to the current game submode handler via the inline jump table.
Clears RAM, initializes HUD and timers, sets starting player coordinates and room from the active demo table, and advances submode.
Initializes room entities and boss state for the attract-mode demo and increments game submode.
Checks pause button toggle and invokes the main frame update routine at 0xD7CE.
Checks Start/Select abort during attract-mode demo and replays timed joypad inputs from the active demo sequence script.
Loads scripted demo input for player 1 from zero-page pointer 0x80 and clears player 2 joypad state.
Toggles the pause flag when Start is pressed during unfrozen non-demo gameplay and plays the pause sound effect.
Initializes rank, health, starting room, and player coordinates for a new game and clears gameplay zero-page work bytes.
Initializes player health, spawn room, and coordinates for a continued game while preserving current rank and card flags.
Dispatches the room initialization mode in 0x2C through the inline jump table at 0xD7CE.
Main active gameplay tick handling pause triggers, radio/transceiver mode, and all entity/world updates.
Executes one full gameplay simulation step covering attacks, projectiles, damage, guard vision, actors, bosses, objectives, pickups, health
Steps periodic player movement in bank 6 for attract-mode demo and runs one gameplay simulation tick.
Dispatches the cutscene/ending handler and restores PRG bank 6.
Switches to UNROM bank 4, invokes routine 0xBCB8, and restores bank 6.
Invokes bank 5 transceiver setup when CHR page is 0xFF, or uploads bank 3 tile data from 0x910A otherwise.
Runs bank 5 transceiver UI updates while active, or clears overlay state, uploads PPU return stream, and switches to mode 8 on Select.
Updates HUD health and rank tiles, switches to UNROM bank 2, and formats a 4-digit readout into the 0x0740 VRAM queue.
Selects UNROM bank 3 via 0xC93E and transfers control into the swapped bank.
Switches to UNROM bank 0, invokes routine 0xB3FC, and restores bank 6.
Runs one gameplay simulation tick, switches to bank 2, converts a counter to 4 BCD digits, and queues the HUD digit VRAM update.
Switches to UNROM bank 5, invokes routine 0xBE6A, and restores bank 6.
Increments the 16-bit pointer stored in zero-page 0x80 by 1.
Decrements the 16-bit counter at zero-page 0x88 by 1 and returns the bitwise OR of its bytes.
Decompresses the current room's 8x6 metatile grid from bank 5/4 into 0x0400-0x06FF and populates the 48-byte room attribute table at 0x0700.
Expands a 4x4 room metatile from PRG bank 4 into the room layout buffer at zero-page 0x88.
Copies four bytes from the source pointer at 0x82 into the destination pointer at 0x88 starting at the given offset.
Loads the 16-bit room data pointer for the current room ID from the active bank's pointer table into zero-page 0x80.
Looks up the current room in the 24-entry hostage table and clears 0x65 if that room's rescue bit is already set.
Animates prisoner sprites, updates rescued-prisoner and destroyed-target bitfields, and triggers radio messages or rank progress.
Counts rescued hostages across 0x72-0x74 into 0x97 and triggers rank-up audio when rescue thresholds are met.
Populates item and key pickup sprites from bank table 0x884E according to the current room and progression flags.
Detects player overlap with room pickup sprites and grants equipment, ammo, rations, cards, or triggers pickup messages and SFX.
Applies a collected ration or ammo pickup, updating player health or weapon stock clamped to the current rank maximum.
Selects PRG bank 2 or 0 based on substate 0x6B and jumps through the inline pointer table for cutscene or ending handling.
Uploads bank 3 pause/equipment menu graphics to PPU_DATA and queues stream 0x13 when CHR stream page is 0xFF.
Updates special gas/equipment room checks, bank 3 and bank 0 environment hooks, delayed actor spawns, and RC missile steering or player acti
Checks screen edge exits, updates shield/weapon auxiliary sprite 1 and player OAM sprite coords, and dispatches player action state 0x3C.
Checks whether the player stands on a special room trigger tile and plays sound effect 0x0E or 0x0D.
Advances the player's coordinates by one pixel in the current facing direction and increments step counter 0x3C.
Reads player D-pad input, updates player position and facing direction, handles special room boundaries, and tests front tile collisions.
Sets player facing direction and sprite tile, checks front collision or door/hazard interactions, and nudges player coordinates on free tile
Runs hazard tile checks and pushes player coordinates 1 pixel in the current facing direction.
Probes two directional bounding points against the room tile map using 0xE55F and returns the resulting collision code.
Probes two tile positions ahead of the player based on facing direction and returns the matching collision or interaction code.
Samples the room layout tile at the pixel coordinates in zero-page 0x80 and returns its collision classification.
Checks if the player stands on a hazard tile in special rooms, decrements player health periodically with sound, and updates animation state
Stores the threshold in 0x81 and nudges player sprite slot 0 X position by one pixel on active frames.
Advances the player punch animation timer, toggles the fist sprite X offset, and updates player sprite state.
Detects when the player crosses a screen boundary or special exit, adjusts entry coordinates, loads the adjacent room via bank 4, and sets m
Configures sprite slot 1 with tile 0x39 at fixed Y 0x5C and X set to player Y minus 0x10.
Scans enemy line-of-sight along axes toward the player to trigger alert mode, or ticks down the alert timer and resumes room BGM.
Activates alert mode for the detecting actor in 0x88, displays the alert marker sprite, and triggers alert BGM.
Displays the exclamation alert sprite above a spotting guard, triggers alert mode and reinforcement cleanup, and plays alert BGM.
Scans the first four actor slots for an active enemy when not already alerted and triggers alert mode.
Updates periodic hazard/gas health drain, player post-hit invulnerability blink timer, and actor/hazard collision checks.
Tests bounding-box overlap between the player and active actor slots to apply contact damage, alert triggers, or damage SFX.
Switches to PRG bank 1 to load the current room's door and transition pointer into zero-page 0x88, then restores bank 6.
Periodically checks player tile collision and room flags to handle door entry and room transition triggers.
Checks special room flags or loads the room door pointer and probes the tile at the player's position before dispatching directional handlin
Searches the room door list for a matching vertical door at the player's position, queues VRAM tile clear writes, and opens the door.
Clears room init mode 0x2C and pushes the player 1 pixel in their facing direction after hazard checks.
Reads a two-byte pair backwards from the pointer in 0x88 into zero-page scratch registers 0x8C and 0x8D.
Increments door loop index 0x91, decrements remaining count 0x90, and returns the entry offset advanced by 7.
Sets room transition state 0x39 using the matched door index with bit 6 set and clears room init mode.
Adds 32 to the 16-bit value in zero-page 0x8C-0x8D with carry propagation.
Subtracts 0x1C (28) from zero-page scratch byte 0x8D.
Adds 0x1C (28) to zero-page scratch byte 0x8D.
Searches the room door list for a matching horizontal door at the player's position, queues VRAM tile clear writes, and opens the door.
Adjusts the door VRAM destination address, records it in the transfer queue, plays door SFX if triggered, and clears room transition state.
Scans horizontal door records in 0x88 against player position and direction and triggers transition if unlocked.
Searches the room door list for a matching left/right gate or elevator at the player's position and queues VRAM tile updates.
Advances the player's Y tile probe coordinate by 2 and invokes the door/gate matcher at index 3.
Verifies whether a matched door record is unlocked by checking room init mode, bit 3 flags, and player action state.
Matches a player-triggered door or teleport entry against required card/direction, updates coordinates, and transitions via bank 4.
Computes an offset by adding a stride of 5 bytes for the specified number of iterations.
Checks room eligibility, player state, and A-button input before finding a free weapon slot and dispatching player attack.
Finds a free slot in 0x5D-0x5F to deploy an item from stock 0x7A, decrements stock, and plays sound 0x26.
Activates slot 0x52 using item stock 0x7B when available, updates inventory flag bit 2, and plays sound 0x26.
Checks weapon cooldowns and ammo counters in 0x7C and 0x7F and plays the corresponding firing sound effect.
Allocates an available mine slot if the player has mines remaining, decrements inventory, spawns the mine, and plays placement SFX.
Fires a player projectile every 8 frames when button A is held and plays either silenced or standard gunshot audio.
Plays sound effect 0x11 when flag 0x79 is nonzero or sound effect 0x24 otherwise.
Finds a free player weapon slot, computes directional spawn coordinates and sprite ID, plays gunshot SFX if unsuppressed, and stores project
Ticks active enemy projectiles, explosive fuse timers, mine detonation checks, and active player weapon slots 2-7.
Advances the active projectile sprite by direction and speed, despawning it when it leaves screen bounds.
Deactivates the projectile indexed by zero-page 0x85 and clears its status nibble in 0x4E or 0x61.
Deactivates the specified projectile slot, resets associated player weapon flags, and clears its status nibble.
Advances a player or enemy projectile, checks screen bounds and tile solidity, tests actor/player hitboxes, and applies damage.
Tests projectile tile solidity and checks hitbox overlap against the player or actors, applying damage on impact.
Checks an explosive or boss-targeting weapon slot against actor slots 8-15, destroys hit targets or damages bosses, and updates room clear s
Tests whether a projectile sprite overlaps a target actor or player hitbox and deactivates the projectile on impact.
Iterates over enemy projectile slots 0x10-0x15 during active boss fights and steps each active projectile using its packed direction nibble.
Builds and queues PPU tile updates in 0x0740 for the HUD health gauge and player rank indicator.
Initializes boss encounter state, health, and sprite coordinates for boss rooms, or selects bank 2 for room 0x76.
Checks if the current room has an active boss, applies pending weapon hits, and dispatches boss AI in PRG bank 2.
Checks whether the current room is in the 10-entry item table and returns 1 if its collection bit is still clear.
Decrements boss hit count and HP using the weapon damage table and triggers boss defeat handling and explosion SFX on zero HP.
Stores the given state value into 0x55 when scratch flag 0x87 equals 3, or into 0x44 otherwise.
Switches to PRG bank 0 to initialize room hazard actors and restores bank 6.
Initializes boss or multi-sprite room props in OAM shadow tables 0x0308-0x035F when entering matching special rooms.
Switches to PRG bank 0 and dispatches room-specific gimmick updates such as traps or special hazards based on room ID.
